evals.prompt: 帮我做个欢迎界面，我叫 Luna，是个独立音乐人，风格是电子流行
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file with a glowing neon gradient welcome screen featuring Luna's name, music theme decorations, and Y2K/trendy aesthetic

assertions.description: Output HTML file exists and is non-empty
Page contains the name 'Luna'
CSS includes linear-gradient or radial-gradient for background
CSS includes @keyframes animation
CSS includes text-shadow for neon glow effect
Page references music, sound, or performance (e.g. 音乐, music, sound, 电子, pop)
File has no broken external dependencies (no local file src= references)

evals.prompt: 生成一个活动宣传页，主题是「2025 毕业季派对」，要有青春感和节日氛围
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file with festive, youthful party vibes, graduation theme, vibrant colors and animated elements

assertions.description: Output HTML file exists and is non-empty
Page contains '2025' or graduation-related text (毕业, graduate, graduation)
CSS includes linear-gradient or radial-gradient for background
CSS includes @keyframes animation
CSS includes text-shadow or box-shadow for festive glow
Page includes decorative elements (stars ✦✧★, confetti, or emoji for festive vibe)
File has no broken external dependencies

evals.prompt: 做一个个人作品集首页，设计师风格，要酷炫时髦，有霓虹灯效果
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file for a designer portfolio intro with neon effects, modern typography, and stylish layout

assertions.description: Output HTML file exists and is non-empty
CSS includes both text-shadow AND box-shadow for neon lamp effect
CSS includes linear-gradient or radial-gradient
CSS includes @keyframes animation
Page includes a button or call-to-action element
Page references portfolio, design, work, or project (作品, 设计, portfolio, work)
File has no broken external dependencies
